title: BidScout Federal Contracts Intelligence
description: Analyze federal procurement opportunities, detect incumbent contractors, and map competitive landscapes.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search term for opportunity titles or contract descriptions (e.g. 'cybersecurity', 'cloud migration')

naicsCode.title: NAICS Code
naicsCode.description: 6-digit NAICS industry code (e.g. '541512' for Computer Systems Design)

agency.title: Agency Filter
agency.description: Federal agency name to filter results

state.title: State
state.description: 2-letter state code for place of performance (e.g. 'VA', 'CA')

postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within Days
postedWithinDays.description: Only show opportunities posted within N days (for search_opportunities)

expiringWithinMonths.title: Expiring Within Months
expiringWithinMonths.description: Look-ahead window for expiring contracts (for detect_incumbents)

lookbackYears.title: Lookback Years
lookbackYears.description: Years of historical data to analyze (for competitive_landscape)
